sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2017 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohd. Ayyub Siddiqui
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Verma,Vinod Kumar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J. 
1. Heard Sri Atul Verma, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Jayant Singh Tomar, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. This second bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 86 of 2021, under Sections 323, 504, 506, 376, 328 IPC, Police Station Husainganj, District Lucknow.
3. First bail application was rejected by this Court by means of an order dated 14.06.2022 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 12272 of 2021.

sentences.text:
4. A copy of the questionnaire issued by the trial court has been annexed with the rejoinder affidavit filed along with the applicant which indicates that the trial court has not even framed charges till 19.05.2023 and a copy of the FSL report has also not been brought on record till date.
5.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 05.06.2021 and even charges have not been framed till date whereas the allegations are not supported by the medico legal examination report and by the statement of the independent witness, who is the landlord of the house, coupled with the fact that Mohd. Ayyub Siddiqui vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. ... on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92043011/
1 the applicant has no previous criminal history, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid case.
